purpose: Define the minimum cases required to size and validate the T-5.6 trunk-to-shoulder load path and single-side test article.
approval_rule: A load case is approved only when all referenced inputs and geometry are locked, the pose and restraints are dimensioned, safety factors are assigned, and numeric pass/fail criteria are recorded.

load_cases.name: static_arm_weight_and_payload
load_cases.boundary_condition: thoracic root fixture restrained at the representative inner-housing and spine interfaces
load_cases.load_application: gravity and payload reactions applied through the dummy humerus across the approved shoulder poses

load_cases.name: commanded_arm_acceleration_and_stop
load_cases.boundary_condition: representative thoracic root fixture with selected guides, bearings, stops, and retention installed
load_cases.load_application: commanded acceleration, deceleration, and ordinary stop across the approved trajectory

load_cases.name: accidental_fore_aft_and_lateral_push_pull
load_cases.boundary_condition: arm held at the load-case poses with physical stops and passive retention active
load_cases.load_application: fore-aft and lateral forces applied at defined humeral or hand-equivalent stations

load_cases.name: minor_contact_impact_and_hard_stop_event
load_cases.boundary_condition: guards, compliant stop elements, sensors, and secondary retention installed
load_cases.load_application: approved impact pulse or equivalent energy at the representative arm station and mechanical travel limits

load_cases.name: controlled_power_loss_arm_retention
load_cases.boundary_condition: actuator torque removed at the critical approved poses
load_cases.load_application: gravity-driven arm reaction with passive retention, damping, and physical limits active

load_cases.name: supported_recline_and_side_contact
load_cases.boundary_condition: body supported in the defined reclined and validated side-contact postures
load_cases.load_application: distributed support reactions through compliant contour layers with shoulder assemblies installed

load_cases.name: maintenance_handling_and_cartridge_replacement
load_cases.boundary_condition: article safely supported in each approved maintenance posture
load_cases.load_application: handling, tool, extraction, insertion, and re-zeroing forces at defined service interfaces

load_cases.name: simultaneous_bilateral_arm_motion
load_cases.boundary_condition: paired shoulder assemblies installed on a representative inner housing and segmented spine interface
load_cases.load_application: symmetric and asymmetric simultaneous arm trajectories including emergency stop

load_cases.name: spine_to_sacral_bridge_load_transfer
load_cases.boundary_condition: bilateral hip nodes restrained according to the approved support posture
load_cases.load_application: trunk gravity, shoulder reactions, bending, and torsion transferred through the inner housing and segmented spine

explicit_scope_questions: Are human lifting and transfer permanently out of scope or a future rated mode?
Must either arm ever support body weight?
What event separates minor domestic impact from crash or fall loading?
Which reclined and side-contact postures are required rather than merely possible?
What passive behavior is required after complete power loss?
How much primary shoulder reaction may bypass into the secondary carbon ribcage?
